items: Holes and screws: counterbored, countersunk and tapped holes in metric sizes, and screws that drop straight into them
Screws and tapped holes get real threads you can 3D print, with a clearance so they fit
Boolean subtract and Extrude Remove take a clearance offset, for parts that need to fit
Use the keyboard shortcuts D (hole) and U (screw) to try them out
Gears: easily add spur and ring gears, with automatic placement and tooth alignment in parts and assemblies
Use the keyboard shortcut G to try it out
Assemblies: join parts with mates, gears and screws
Animate a mate and save it as a video or GIF
Just press New → Assembly and insert parts from any of your documents
Type a circle's radius or diameter while drawing it
Work offline after your first visit
